title: 35,000 in Massachusetts Could Lose Health Coverage, Official Warns
description:
An official warns that federal policy will end health coverage for 35,000 people in Massachusetts. This Massachusetts update covers the warning reported October 7, 2026, and the distinction between a projected coverage loss and people already losing insurance. The focus is what the warning means for household budgeting, without claiming that replacement premiums or individual eligibility details have been confirmed.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#Massachusettshealthcoverage #Massachusettshealthinsurancenews #Bostonlocalnews #Massachusettsdailynews #Massachusettsgasprices
